stance_rationale: Nominal IC gates pass, but the package breaches hard process constraints: universe enforcement is absent, Factor DB loading bypasses C15, forward-return diagnostics overlap lockbox, and the claimed multi-sleeve defense axis collapses into Q07-heavy exposure. This is not a safe alpha handoff until the artifacts are rerun through the mandated PIT harness and universe.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: RF-A7 single-snapshot risk is low, but only 116169 of 329683 rows have non-null score_eff; package date_range says 2003-12-01 start while parquet starts 2004-01-01; the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260425_010 path was absent and only stage_artifacts/WT_D20260425_010 existed.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Signals dated 2023-12-01 and 2024-01-01 consume forward returns overlapping or inside the 2024-01-23 lockbox window.
Q25_Ohlson_O is claimed as aligned, but its standalone IC is negative and theta_defense is Q07=1,Q25=0 for most artifact rows.
Bulk parquet read selects Ticker, Factor_Name, Z_Score, Coverage only; no Usable_Date <= sig_date guard is executed in the alpha engine.
factor_engine_proposal.R directly reads factor_db_YYYYMM.parquet and rationalizes it as load_month_factors equivalent/in spirit.
Regime state is reused from Iter 2 regime_panel and is not the primary blocker.
Fundamental lag is asserted through Factor DB, but the direct parquet path prevents artifact-level verification of annual May/quarterly 45d usability.
AvgTV20 is align-right and liquidity membership uses RAWDATA[Date == sig_d] or closest date, so same-day volume can enter eligibility.

critical_concerns.description: Latest alpha_scores has 694 valid names, but only 259 are in KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 on the nearest raw-data date; 14 of the top 20 alpha names are outside the mandated universe.
C15 forbids direct Factor DB parquet loading; this engine bulk-reads factor_db_*.parquet and spot-checks only one Q07 month against load_month_factors.
The package certifies lockbox isolation, yet IC diagnostics include forward returns for 2023-12 and 2024-01 signals that overlap the sealed lockbox period.
Subperiod stability is 0.278 versus the 0.50 gate, with IC decaying from 0.0644 to 0.0179 across subperiods.
Selected blend ICIR 0.5766 is below Q07 standalone ICIR 0.7519 and below the stated defense sleeve 0.7200; the package does not prove added factor value.
The defense sleeve is presented as Q07+Q25 multi-axis, but Q25 has zero weight in most rows; this weakens AX-004, AX-005, and AX-007 exception claims and raises L-219 family saturation risk.
Harvey evidence is a simple IC t-stat, not Newey-West HAC portfolio regression across CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 specs; 5-spec multi-testing is deferred.
challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, and the requested 3-agent context files were unavailable, so AX-008 triangulation cannot pass.
Sector-neutral IC is not reported, time_series_tdc_iter3_proxy is NaN, and cross-section Jaccard vs Iter 3 is 0.739, above the intended crowding threshold.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 is not triggered: alpha_scores.parquet contains 241 monthly sig_dates, regular month-start dates, and no future dates.
RF-A3 is not triggered: recent 3Y ICIR is 0.243 versus full ICIR 0.577, ratio 0.42.
RF-A5 direct illiquidity is not triggered for latest top 20: audited minimum AvgTV20 was about 224.6m KRW, above 2e8, though C10 lag remains unresolved.
Simple decile monotonicity from the parquet is 0.889, but the package reports monotonicity as NA.
unresolved_disputes: Whether IC/ICIR remain above gate after rerunning strictly inside KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150.
Whether Q25_Ohlson_O is direction-aligned correctly and contributes nonzero alpha.
Whether diagnostics remain stable when every factor month is loaded through load_month_factors() with Usable_Date evidence.
Whether turnover, weights schedule, PSD covariance, and condition number can pass, since weights.csv and covariance.parquet were absent.
Whether DSR=0.576 is reproducible from a clean successful run log.
weakest_assumption: The weakest claim is that the 0.65/0.35 multi-sleeve blend is a validated cross-family alpha; the artifact instead looks like a universe-unconstrained, Q07/consensus-dominated score blend with failed stability and weak evidence of incremental factor value.
rebuttal_required: Rerun alpha generation through load_month_factors() for every sig_date and attach Usable_Date <= sig_date evidence.
Apply the KOSPI200 ∪ KOSDAQ150 universe before ranking and regenerate top 20 alpha_vector.
Remove all forward-return windows overlapping lockbox and recompute IC diagnostics.
Prove Q25 sign alignment and nonzero contribution, or withdraw the AX-004/AX-005/AX-007 exception claim.
Provide challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, sector-neutral IC, crowding TDC, clean DSR reproduction, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Only the alpha draft and B-stage alpha artifacts were available; A-stage artifacts, risk/optimizer packages, weights, covariance, challenge note, and lineage evidence were missing.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the alpha still pass rank_IC >= 0.04 and ICIR >= 0.20 after universe enforcement and lockbox-safe return exclusion?
Why was Blend_065_035 selected under selection_objective=icir when Blend_050_050 reports a higher ICIR in the shopping log?
If Q25 is the distress axis supporting the defense sleeve, why is theta_defense Q25=0 in most rows and why is its standalone IC negative after claimed alignment?
